segmentation_contract.foreground_mask: SAM3_Detect masks output 0; one foreground, zero background. Saved mask is PNG image artifact.
segmentation_contract.cutout_alpha: InvertMask before JoinImageWithAlpha, whose implementation applies 1-mask. Final opacity equals SAM foreground mask.
segmentation_contract.segmented_image: Source composited over dynamically sized white image using direct foreground mask; suitable opaque input for native multiview/geometry.
segmentation_contract.strategy: Frontier chooses placement, target text, detection parameters, outputs and subsequent Workflow; this is capability metadata only.
segmentation_contract.native_validation: All required inputs, link types, nodes and checkpoint choice checked against live /object_info. No POST or inference performed by observer.
segmentation_contract.source: Installed SAM3 image schema and image/mask compositing implementations.

Frontier가 현재 계약에 따라 자신의 PLAN을 새로 판단할 수 있다. 기존 거절과 원본은 보존되었고 Tool dispatch는 없었다.

geometry_color_contract.graph: Hunyuan3D_MV_RTX4060_api.json contains shape conditioning, VoxelToMesh and SaveGLB only.
geometry_color_contract.mesh_constructor: VoxelToMesh builds Types.MESH(vertices, faces) without vertex colors, UVs or texture.
geometry_color_contract.limitation: Colored conditioning images alone do not give this native graph a painted mesh. A separate coloring strategy is needed for painted deliverable criteria.
geometry_color_contract.diagnostic_limitation: Current blender-diagnose uses neutral SINGLE Workbench color, which does not prove original material/paint colors.
geometry_color_contract.inventory: Installed PaintMesh requires colored VOXEL input. Current Hunyuan graph does not produce that color field. Registered Trellis2 nodes alone are not model availability or success attestation.
geometry_color_contract.authority: Frontier chooses strategy and may request concrete Host capability support; frozen criteria remain unchanged. Do not infer color success or weaken criteria.

reference_color_projection_contract.native_node: ReferenceImageMeshColors installed under native custom_nodes/loopcore_reference_mesh_colors. Server reload/live registration check required.
reference_color_projection_contract.method: Actual current source RGB projected on Hunyuan-generated vertices; vertices/faces preserved. No model download, procedural stripe assignment, calibrated reconstruction claim or quality attestation.
reference_color_projection_contract.inputs: White-background isolated and generated views. X horizontal/Y vertical defaults in Comfy native Y-up coordinates; left_angle=45, right_angle=-45, back=180. Frontier may choose strategy/axis/view patches.
reference_color_projection_contract.limitations: Reference projection approximates perspective, occlusion and hidden surfaces; new independent review must judge C1-C3.
reference_color_projection_contract.diagnostic: Fresh GLB import now renders existing image textures or vertex colors (neutral studio lighting), otherwise material color; metrics declare mode and color-data presence.
reference_color_projection_contract.host_support: Support 04 resolves requested local Comfy mesh-color strategy with native current RGB projection and material-aware diagnostics. Previous shape-only graph remains immutable. Frontier must revise Workflow; exact hashes and original checkpoints matter.
